units.source_text: 源氏公子见惟光出来，怪道：“你为何去得如此长久？

en.t: When Prince Genji saw Koremitsu come out, he asked suspiciously, "Why were you gone so long?
How is that person after all?

units.source_text: 荒草长得这么繁茂，从前的迹象全然看不出了！”

en.t: The wild grasses have grown so thick that no trace of the past can be seen at all!"

units.source_text: 惟光告道：只因如此如此，好容易找到了人。

en.t: Koremitsu reported that, because of such and such circumstances, he had at last managed to find someone.

units.source_text: 又说：“说话的老侍女，是侍从的叔母，叫作少将。

en.t: He added, "The old gentlewoman who spoke is Jijuu's aunt, and she is called Shoushou.

units.source_text: 她的声音我从前听到过，是熟悉的。”

en.t: I had heard her voice before, so it was familiar to me."

units.source_text: 便把末摘花的近况一一禀告。

en.t: Then he reported every detail of Suetsumuhana's recent situation.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，想道：“真可怜呵！

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, he thought, "How pitiful!

units.source_text: 在这荒草丛中度日子，多么悲惨！

en.t: How miserable it must be to pass her days amid these wild grasses!

units.source_text: 为什么我不早点来访问呢？”

en.t: Why did I not come to visit her sooner?"

units.source_text: 他埋怨自己无情，说道：“那么怎么办呢？

en.t: He reproached himself for his coldness and said, "Then what should be done?

units.source_text: 我这样微行出门，是不容易的。

en.t: It is not easy for me to go out secretly like this.

units.source_text: 今晚若非乘便，还不会来呢。

en.t: If tonight had not offered a convenient chance, I still would not have come.

units.source_text: 小姐矢志不变，便可推想她的性情多么坚贞。”

en.t: If the lady has remained steadfast in her resolve, one can imagine how firm and faithful her nature is."

units.source_text: 然而立刻进去，又觉得唐突，总得先派人送一首诗进去才像样子。

en.t: Yet going in at once seemed abrupt, and it would be proper first to send someone in with a poem.

units.source_text: 又念如果她同以前相见时一样默不作声，要使者久久等候她的答诗，对不起使者。

en.t: He also thought that if she stayed silent as she had when they met before, making the messenger wait long for her reply poem would be unfair to the messenger.

units.source_text: 便决定不先送诗，立即进去。

en.t: So he decided not to send a poem first, and went in at once.
